scene.heading: SALES GROWTH · EACH COMPANY'S LATEST QUARTER

say: So how did D Mart do against other retailers? Here's the race. Trent's sales grew twenty three percent. Vishal Mega Mart's, eighteen point seven. D Mart's, eighteen point four. V-Mart's, eighteen. And Reliance Retail's, seven point four. D Mart is running with the pack.
